support_text: In the present study, we revealed that treatment with LCZ696 was able to suppress the expression of Arginase-1 and CD163, two markers of M2 macrophage polarization. Mechanistically... we also found that LCZ696 inhibited the phosphorylation of STAT6. These data indicated that LCZ696 may suppress M2 macrophage polarization by regulating the STAT6 signaling pathway. A higher level of TGF-β1 was observed in culture medium of Raw264.7 cells stimulated with IL-4; administration with LCZ696 significantly reduced the secretion of TGF-β1.
